accordions.title: How it works
accordions.body: Most cinnamon supplements don't work because they rely on cheap Cassia powder pressed into hard capsules that are difficult for your stomach to break down properly. The active compounds get stuck in fiber and move through your body largely untouched.Metabolae takes a different approach. We start with genuine Ceylon cinnamon from Sri Lanka, concentrate it 12-to-1 into a smooth liquid extract, then blend it with MCT oil and encase it in easy-to-swallow softgels.Once the softgel dissolves, the extract is already suspended in oil, creating a highly bioavailable form your body can take in efficiently.No rough powder.No cinnamon aftertaste hours afterward.No active compounds going to waste.MCT oil works as a natural transport system, carrying the concentrated Ceylon cinnamon compounds into your bloodstream to support healthy glucose metabolism, circulation, and cellular wellness.A single softgel each day delivers the equivalent of 7,200 mg of Ceylon cinnamon. The potency that dozens of standard capsules try to match, in a form your body can genuinely absorb.It's why so many adults over 50 who had written off cinnamon supplements entirely are finally feeling a genuine difference with Metabolae.
